text: dsh-agent-session-tools 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Agent 的会话管理插件。它在 Host 侧注册四个工具，调用宿主的 sessionController 服务来创建会话、向指定会话投递消息、列出可见会话和取消当前轮次。投递支持排队等待下一轮处理，或在当前轮的步骤边界引导；创建时可选择工作目录、预设和标题。适合需要让 Agent 跨会话分派工作、同步消息或管理会话的场景。代码没有声明 API 密钥或外部服务要求。

dsh-agent-session-tools adds four DeepSeek Harness tools: create sessions, send queued or steering messages, list sessions, and cancel a running turn. It uses the host sessionController service. No API key or external service is declared.
想让 Agent 新建一个独立的 DSH 会话来分派工作。
如何把一条消息发到指定会话，让它排队处理或立即调整当前任务？
dsh-agent-session-tools 的功能「跨会话管理」：Agent 可创建会话、投递排队或引导消息、查看可见会话并取消运行中的轮次。调用对应工具并传入参数，可获得会话 ID、接收状态、列表或取消状态。
dsh-agent-session-tools 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 11 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · dsh-agent-session-tools：**给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 用的会话工具：新建一个会话，往任意会话里投递消息。**

给 Agent 一组能直接操作会话的工具——不用绕提示词、不用打开界面，就能从当前会话里新建一个对接会话，或把一句话塞进另一个正在跑的会话。

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 它解决什么问题：Harness 内核里，Agent 想给「别的会话」发消息，原本只有两条窄路：

- `agentTeams.sendMessage`：只能发给自己的 teammate；
- `subagents.sendMessage`：只能发给直接父会话或直接可续子会话。

**没有对任意会话的通用入口。** 于是常见需求全都做不了：从主会话派活给一个独立会话、把结论同步回另一条对话、叫停一个卡住的会话。

本插件补上这个入口。它不自己造轮子，而是直接调用已组合的宿主服务 `ctx.sessionController`——也就是 Web 界面输入框「发送消息」走的同一条投递路径。因此注入的消息在目标会话里就是一条真实的用户消息，不是某种旁门注入。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 特点：- **单文件、零依赖、零构建**：运行时代码只有 `index.js` 一个文件，只用内置 `node:path`，不打包任何第三方依赖，也没有构建步骤。改完 `index.js` **重启 DSH 即生效**——不用重装、不用编译、不用等打包。（不重启不生效：Loader 按包名缓存已导入的模块，禁用/启用也不会重读。）
- **卸载无副作用**：卸载只移除这个插件的加载行和包目录。它不写任何配置、不建数据目录、不注册后台任务、不接管现有会话，卸完 Harness 回到装之前的样子。唯一要说明的是使用痕迹——**已经注入的消息留在目标会话日志里，卸载不会撤销它们**；那是注入这一步造成的，不是卸载造成的。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 提供的工具：| 工具 | 作用 | 底层调用 |
|---|---|---|
| `session_create` | 新建会话，返回 `sessionId` | `sessionController.create()` |
| `session_inject` | 向指定会话投递一条消息 | `sessionController.prompt()` |
| `session_list` | 列出可见会话，用于找 `sessionId` | `sessionController.list()` |
| `session_cancel` | 取消某会话当前正在跑的轮次 | `sessionController.cancel()` |

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_create：| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | 否 | 新会话工作目录的**绝对路径**；省略用 Harness 默认目录。传相对路径会被拒绝（宿主进程的当前目录调用方看不到，不替调用方猜） |
| `agentPreset` | 否 | 预设 id；省略用默认预设 |
| `title` | 否 | 创建后立即设置的标题 |

返回 `{ sessionId, agentPreset?, title?, warning? }`。标题设置失败不影响会话创建，失败原因放进 `warning`。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_inject：| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | 是 | 目标会话 |
| `message` | 是 | 注入的文本，不能为空 |
| `mode` | 否 | `queue`（默认，排队到下一轮）或 `steer`（立即引导当前轮） |

返回 `{ accepted, sessionId, mode, requestId }`。两种投递语义：

- `queue`：消息进入该会话收件箱，在它下一轮开始时被处理；目标空闲时也会被唤醒起一轮。
- `steer`：消息在该会话最近一个步骤边界生效，用于中途改变方向。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_list：| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | 否 | 最多返回多少条，默认 20，范围 1–100 |

只读存储，不会唤醒冷会话。每行带 `running` / `blank` / `origin` / `cwd`，便于挑目标。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_cancel：| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | 是 | 目标会话 |

只发取消请求，**不丢弃**已排队的消息。会话卡在未结算的工具调用上时，它是唯一能救回来的手段：取消后那一轮结束，队列才继续动。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 方式一：从 GitHub 装（推荐）：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zgq0106/dsh-agent-session-tools
```

`--profile` 换成你自己的 profile 名（`dsh` 的插件目录就是 profile 目录，包里没有构建步骤，装完直接可用）。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 方式二：本地目录：把仓库 `git clone` 到本机，然后二选一：

- 用 Harness 的插件管理器，安装目标填该目录的**绝对路径**（宿主会读它的 `package.json`，并写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`）；
- 或手工链接：把目录链接到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-agent-session-tools`，再在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: agent-session-tools
      name: dsh-agent-session-tools
```
dsh-agent-session-tools README · 装完要重启：Host 半侧（本包全部代码）按包名缓存已导入的模块：**禁用/启用、重装 bundle 都不会重新读取 `index.js`，只有重启 DSH 才保证新代码生效。**
dsh-agent-session-tools README · 与旧版 `@local/dsh-session-control` 的关系：本包由作者此前自用的私有版泛化而来，工具与行为一致。若你之前装过那个私有版，请先移除再装本包——两个插件会注册同名工具（`session_create` 等），同时启用属于未测组合。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 安全边界：- **注入是真实写入**：消息会进目标会话日志，等于有人在那儿说了那句话，不可撤销。建议先拿一个不重要的会话试一次。
- **工具不做内容审查**：调用方（Agent）为注入内容负责；插件只是忠实转发。
- **空文本会被拒绝**：`prompt` 要求非空白文本或附件，插件侧先拦一次，错误信息直接说明原因。
- **消息归属**：插件在宿主进程内调用、不带 Remote 主体，因此注入的消息按 **owner** 归属，与你手打的消息同级。
- **幂等**：每次调用生成唯一 `requestId`；服务端对重复 `requestId` 返回原接受结果，不会重复插入。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 与同类插件的区别：社区里已有相近的插件，动手前值得知道：

- [`dsh-session-bridge`](https://github.com/heartmove/dsh-session-bridge)：通过提示词创建顶层会话、发消息、等待回复、读消息、按会话名跨工作区查找，还带监控与子代理处置——功能比本包宽得多。
- [`dsh-session-hub`](https://github.com/Asaiuta/dsh-session-hub)：从同一面板聚合控制多台远程 dsh web 服务器上的会话。

本包刻意做得更窄：**纯宿主内工具层**，直接调 `sessionController`，不经提示词、不加界面、不依赖前台页面、不带定时与聚合。四个工具、参数严格、错误信息明确、`requestId` 幂等。窄的好处是行为和边界都容易预期——你要是只需要「建个会话」「往那边说句话」，它不会顺带做别的。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 兼容性：| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 实测 DSH | `0.2.1-rc.5`（Windows，Node 24.21.0） |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0`（与 DSH 生态插件同口径） |
| 依赖 | 只用 `ctx.sessionController` 与内置 `node:path`，不打包任何第三方依赖 |
| 构建 | 无。`index.js` 就是发布产物 |

`package.json` 的 `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 只写**实测过**的版本，不声明没验证过的范围。别的版本大概率也能跑（只用了稳定的宿主服务接口），但请以你的实测为准。

宿主没有组合 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 时，插件仍会加载、工具仍在，但调用会返回一条说明缺什么服务的错误，而不是静默失败。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · 开发与测试：```sh
node --check index.js
node test/smoke.mjs        # 或 npm test
```

`test/smoke.mjs` 离线运行：用一个假的 Cordis 上下文和桩 `sessionController` 驱动真实的 `apply()`，覆盖注册形状、四个工具的每条 `execute()` 路径、参数拒绝与幂等。不需要 DSH 进程、端口或交互。

dsh-agent-session-tools README · dsh-agent-session-tools：**Session tools for DeepSeek Harness agents: create a session, and deliver a message into any session.**

[简体中文](README.md) | English

dsh-agent-session-tools README · The gap it fills：Inside Harness an agent can only message other sessions through two narrow paths:

- `agentTeams.sendMessage` — only to its own teammates;
- `subagents.sendMessage` — only to a direct parent or a directly continuable child.

There is **no general entry point** for an arbitrary session. So an agent cannot hand work to a standalone session, push a result back into another conversation, or stop a stuck one.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · The gap it fills：This plugin adds that entry point. It does not reimplement anything: it calls the already-composed Host service `ctx.sessionController` — the very admission path the Web composer uses. An injected message therefore lands in the target session as a durable user message, not as a side-channel write.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Why it stays light：- **Single file, zero dependencies, zero build.** The runtime is just `index.js`, using only built-in `node:path`; nothing third-party is bundled and there is no build step. Edit `index.js`, **restart DSH, and the change is live** — no reinstall, no compile, no bundling wait. (The restart is required: the Loader caches imported Host modules per package name, so disabling/enabling does not re-read the file.)
- **Uninstalling leaves nothing behind.** Removal drops the plugin's loader row and its package directory — no config writes, no data directory, no background tasks, no takeover of existing sessions. Harness returns to its pre-install state. The one caveat is usage rather than installation: **messages already injected stay in the target session logs; uninstalling does not recall them.**

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Tools：| Tool | What it does | Underlying call |
|---|---|---|
| `session_create` | Create a session, return its `sessionId` | `sessionController.create()` |
| `session_inject` | Deliver one message into a session | `sessionController.prompt()` |
| `session_list` | List visible sessions, to find an id | `sessionController.list()` |
| `session_cancel` | Cancel a session's running turn | `sessionController.cancel()` |

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_create：| Parameter | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | no | **Absolute** working directory for the new session; omit for the Harness default. A relative path is rejected rather than resolved against the Host process's cwd, which the caller cannot see |
| `agentPreset` | no | Agent preset id; omit for the configured default |
| `title` | no | Set the title right after creation |
dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_create：Returns `{ sessionId, agentPreset?, title?, warning? }`. A failed title is non-fatal: the session is still created and the reason ends up in `warning`.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_inject：| Parameter | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | yes | Target session |
| `message` | yes | Non-empty text |
| `mode` | no | `queue` (default: handled at the next turn) or `steer` (applied at the next step boundary) |

Returns `{ accepted, sessionId, mode, requestId }`.

- `queue` — enters the session inbox and is handled when the next turn starts; it also wakes an idle session.
- `steer` — takes effect at the session's next step boundary, to change direction mid-turn.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_list：| Parameter | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | no | Rows to return, default 20, range 1–100 |

Read-only, never wakes a cold session. Each row carries `running` / `blank` / `origin` / `cwd`.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · session_cancel：| Parameter | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | yes | Target session |

Sends a cancel request and **keeps** queued messages. When a session is stuck on an unsettled tool call this is the only way back: the turn ends, then the queue moves.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · From GitHub (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zgq0106/dsh-agent-session-tools
```

Replace `--profile` with your own profile name. The package has no build step.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · From a local checkout：Clone the repo, then either point the Harness plugin manager at the directory's absolute path, or link it into `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-agent-session-tools` and append to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: agent-session-tools
      name: dsh-agent-session-tools
```

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Restart is required：The Loader caches an imported Host module per package name: disabling/enabling or reinstalling the bundle does **not** re-read `index.js`. Restart DSH after installing.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Relation to the private `@local/dsh-session-control`：This package is the generalized release of the author's private version, with the same tools and behaviour. If you have that private version installed, remove it first — both register the same tool names (`session_create` etc.), and running them together is untested.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Safety：- **Injection is a real write.** The message joins the target session's log as if spoken there, and cannot be recalled. Try a disposable session first.
- **No content review.** The plugin forwards faithfully; the calling agent owns the content.
- **Empty text is rejected** before it reaches the service.
- **Attribution:** the plugin runs in the Host process without a Remote principal, so injected messages are attributed to the **owner**, at the same level as messages you type.
- **Idempotency:** every call mints a unique `requestId`; a repeated id returns the original acceptance instead of inserting twice.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Similar plugins：- [`dsh-session-bridge`](https://github.com/heartmove/dsh-session-bridge) — creates top-level sessions via prompts, sends messages, waits for replies, reads messages, looks sessions up by name across workspaces, plus monitoring and subagent handling. Much broader.
- [`dsh-session-hub`](https://github.com/Asaiuta/dsh-session-hub) — aggregates and controls sessions across multiple remote dsh web servers from one pane.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Similar plugins：This package stays deliberately narrow: a **Host-only tool layer** that calls `sessionController` directly — no prompt indirection, no UI, no dependency on the open page, no scheduling or aggregation. Four tools, strict parameters, explicit errors, idempotent requests.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Compatibility：| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Verified on | DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`, Windows, Node 24.21.0 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` (same range as DSH ecosystem plugins) |
| Dependencies | Only `ctx.sessionController` and built-in `node:path`; nothing bundled |
| Build | None — `index.js` is the shipped artifact |

`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` lists only versions that were actually tested. Other releases will most likely work (the surface used is stable), but treat that as unverified.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Compatibility：If the profile does not compose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`, the plugin still loads and its tools stay registered; calls then fail with an error naming the missing service instead of failing silently.

dsh-agent-session-tools README · Development：```sh
node --check index.js
node test/smoke.mjs        # or npm test
```

`test/smoke.mjs` runs offline: a fake Cordis context and a stub `sessionController` drive the real `apply()`, covering registration shape, every `execute()` path, argument rejection and idempotency. No DSH process, port or interaction needed.
